name: Redshade turns the Reap button into Thresh and then Bloodshatter
contract: Redshade 524735 promises that using Reap transforms it into Thresh for 10 seconds, and its buff Thresh (Dummy) 525058 says so on the character. Casting Thresh then leaves Bloodshatter (Dummy) 525299 for the second step. Both are plain SPELL_AURA_DUMMY, so aura_ascension_reaper_redshade_transform swaps the button through Player::SetTemporarySpellReplacement: the client redraws it from SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL and the cast handler sends the replacement. A Reaper never learns Thresh or Bloodshatter, so owning the talent is what puts them in the spellbook, once, rather than each buff teaching and forgetting them and announcing both in chat. Both read Generates 1 Soul Fragment and generating Runic Power, and neither record performs either, so ResourceGainRules pays them the way it pays every rank of Reap.
